lines.trans: Wait one minute right outside this door.
Fine, Arkady Borisovich, we are waiting for you here.
I will quickly grab all necessary documents right now.
The car is already parked downstairs in the courtyard.
Is the driver ready to head toward the airport?
Yes, all things have already been loaded into the trunk.
I need to think calmly before the long journey.
Do not worry, our flight departs strictly on time.
I am finally completely free from house arrest.
I congratulate you on the long-awaited city court decision.
Thank you, now a new life begins for us.
We are ready to reliably protect you everywhere.
Excellent, open the door, we are exiting immediately!
